name: @replynodes/sdk
description: Official TypeScript SDK for the ReplyNodes web context API — web scraping, Google Search, YouTube, Reddit and App Store APIs for software and AI agents.

scripts.generate: node scripts/project-public-openapi.js && docker run --rm --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -v "$PWD/..:/local" openapitools/openapi-generator-cli:v7.10.0 generate -i /local/sdk/.generated/replynodes-fetcher.public.openapi.json -g typescript-fetch -o /local/sdk/generated -c /local/sdk/openapi-generator-config.json --skip-validate-spec && find generated/src -type f -name '*.ts' -exec sed -i 's/[[:blank:]]*$//' {} +
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/write-esm-package.js
